purpose: Read and (Admin) change the delegated claims authority matrix: approval and settlement-authorisation limits for adjusters and managers.
prerequisites: Live owning-service record for the policy, application or desk item
business_rules: Only Admin and SuperAdmin change limits; changes are recorded with who made them.
Limits configure authority; they never approve or pay a claim.
Explicit user instruction is required for mutations; backend gates remain authoritative.
approvals: role_operations.TOOL_ROLES mirrors the owning router; the shared permission gate and owning-service checks apply.
recovery: Ask for missing details or offer verified choices; never fill a decision, answer or reference in.
Read the live case before retrying; an unknown mutation outcome is verified, never replayed.
verification: Report only backend-confirmed outcomes; a skipped step is reported as skipped.
